name: Atomic Microsizer — the attack trigger is not static; fired, its target is 1/1 and can't be blocked
notes: Memory: project_cant_rules_and_goaded_as_traits_2026-10-13 (follow-up). "Whenever equipped creature attacks, choose up to one target creature. That creature can't be blocked this turn and has base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn." The enchant/equip transform section read the trigger line and made the EQUIPPED creature 1/1 for good; the fired trigger set nothing, because the base-P/T subject ran on into "can't be blocked this turn and". Now the transform section skips trigger lines of an unfired permanent, and the base-P/T subject drops a can't-rule before its "and".
